selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What does the passage say mercy does for living things that come into this world?
questions.answer: It cares for them and gives them what they need.

questions.question: Which kinds of living things are given special attention in the passage?
questions.answer: All living things, especially the new ones.

questions.question: How are these living things cared for?
questions.answer: They are cared for in a neat, ordered way.

questions.question: What happens to the needs of living things?
questions.answer: Their needs are brought to them.

questions.question: Does the mercy in the passage leave some of them out, or does it remember them all?
questions.answer: It remembers them all.

questions.question: Where does this mercy reach?
questions.answer: It reaches every person and every creature everywhere.

questions.question: When does this mercy reach them?
questions.answer: It reaches them all at the same time.

questions.question: What two ideas does this caring mercy show?
questions.answer: It shows unity and oneness within unity.

questions.question: At the end of the passage, what did the traveler see next?
questions.answer: He saw the Third Truth in the Third Stopping-Place.

questions.question: What did the traveler witness because of this?
questions.answer: The Third Truth in the Third Stopping-Place.

questions.question: What is compared to the truth of Mercifulness at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: The truth of Opening.

questions.question: What does the truth of Opening do with the forms of beings?
questions.answer: It makes and unfolds them in an orderly way.

questions.question: What does that orderly making show very clearly?
questions.answer: It shows unity.

questions.question: What is said about the truth of Mercifulness?
questions.answer: It covers all things.

questions.question: Who does this mercy nurture?
questions.answer: It nurtures all living beings that come into life in this world.

questions.question: Which living beings are pointed out in a special way?
questions.answer: The ones that have just arrived.

questions.question: What kind of order is seen in this mercy?
questions.answer: Great order and regularity.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the needs of these living beings?
questions.answer: Their needs are delivered to them.

questions.question: What does the passage say about missing any of them?
questions.answer: None of them are forgotten.

questions.question: What two truths are shown by this mercy reaching everyone everywhere at once?
questions.answer: Unity and oneness within unity.

questions.question: Does the passage describe mercy as small and limited, or wide and reaching everything?
questions.answer: Wide and reaching everything.

questions.question: What does this mercy do for creatures that begin life in the world?
questions.answer: It supports them and takes care of them.

questions.question: Which group is specially mentioned to help us notice this care?
questions.answer: Newly created living things.

questions.question: What is one sign that this care is perfect?
questions.answer: It is done with order.
